hotels.vendor_name: Amoh, a Luxury Collection Resort, Rhodes
hotels.title: Greek Island Glamour: Rhodes Beachfront Hideaway with Daily Breakfast & Daily EUR50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Carved into an ancient stone quarry on Rhodes' southeastern peninsula, this resort has the mythology of the Dodecanese Islands written into the architecture, spa rituals and culinary concept. Sprawling spa retreat ELISPA features wellness rituals that draw on the island’s renowned healing traditions, while restaurants and bars celebrate the island’s culinary heritage, from seafood-focused house of fine dining Kymata to farm-sourced Mediterranean fare and views over the quarry ruins at Cava di Pietra. Beyond the resort’s peninsula setting, guests discover Rhodes through curated cultural experiences - story nights with local storytellers, ceramic workshops with Rhodian artisans and guided excursions to ancient sites. The iconic village of Lindos captivates with its whitewashed alleyways leading to the dramatic Acropolis perched above the sea, while secluded coves and crystal-clear waters dot the coastline within easy reach of this exclusive retreat.

hotels.vendor_name: Caesars Gardens Hotel & Spa - Adults Only- Rhodes, Greece
hotels.title: Boutique Greek Island Adults-Only Retreat with Outdoor Pool & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Seamlessly blending into Rhodes' natural landscape, this intimate, adults-only hotel is where Greek Island sophistication meets rustic charm. The crown jewel is the Magnolia Spa, featuring outdoor treatment pavillions amid ancient olive trees, while Tárate Restaurant serves traditional Greek cuisine using herbs and vegetables from the hotel's garden. Beyond the hotel's tranquil grounds, guests can explore Rhodes' immense southeastern coastline, with pristine beaches and hidden coves dotting the shoreline. Adventure seekers can discover ancient ruins perched dramatically on clifftops, while the nearby village of Lindos captivates with its maze of whitewashed alleyways, traditional tavernas and local craft boutiques.
